name: followup-baseline
description: Controlled FS-12 Revoker Free Flight cockpit orbit (9000m, 230m/s, bank20) with 600 seconds available for external 30-second off/on/off CPU samples after 30 seconds warmup. Requires recorded aircraft and native pilot survival. The earlier FS-20 bank25 fixture crashed and is preserved as failed evidence. Keep current quality, resolution, VSync and physics settings. The companion sampler only reads runtime data; switch FootprintProfiler with existing telemetry Control between samples. Use window mode and verify actual unlocked/foreground/render conditions before any FPS claim. Base source is 8c58ed08, including AgX removal; retain each deployed DLL fingerprint rather than asserting binary equivalence to another build.
